text: AI is changing the way we work. Many companies now use automation to handle repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help employees finish their work faster and more efficiently. However, AI does not replace people completely. Instead, human-AI collaboration is becoming more common, where workers use AI to support their decisions and creative ideas. This means some jobs are changing, and new skills are needed. Employees may need training to work alongside these tools. Overall, AI offers great opportunities, but it also asks us to adapt and keep learning.
